name: Remember That I Love You
label: Quest
description: In Stormwind, a blood-stained letter is bound for Jeremy Heartweaver. He has left the orphanage for a new home with Avette Fellwood in Duskwood.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, a blood-stained letter is bound for Jeremy Heartweaver. He has left the orphanage for a new home with Avette Fellwood in Duskwood.

Children at the Stormwind Orphanage have lost their families to war, hardship, and the chaos gripping the kingdom. Jeremy Heartweaver was one of them until Avette Fellwood adopted him. She took him to live in Duskwood, where the woods are gloomy and life brings peril and hard labor. The orphanage caretakers believed a home with a family offered him more than remaining in the city.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.
If you see little Jeremy do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It's nice of you to bring this, but I don't think Jeremy is ready to see it. Matron Nightingale said my little Jeremy hasn't spoken since the attack on Lordaeron, and I don't intend to force him now. Showing him this will only cause him more pain.
Don't look at me like that. I won't hide his past from him, but he needs time to heal. I'll give this to him when he's older. Thank you for stopping by, but I think it's time you should go.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
